title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: MCP 2026-07-28 stateless spec is now 2 days out — the breaking rewrite ratifies Tuesday
bullets.summary: The final spec publishes Jul 28 and removes the session handshake, so a remote MCP server can sit behind a plain round-robin load balancer and scale horizontally like any web API; it also brings Extensions/Tasks/MCP Apps, auth hardening and a formal deprecation policy. Scale context: 10,000+ public MCP servers in production, 97M+ monthly SDK downloads.
bullets.how: Every MCP server The Construct runs is 2 days from a breaking change; the migration + least-authority hardening inventory has to close before Tuesday, and the Tasks extension maps straight onto our long-running scan jobs. Load-bearing action of the week.

bullets.title: arXiv: 'LLM Agents Are Latent Context Managers' (VISTA) — updated Jul 23
bullets.summary: VISTA (Visible Internal State for Tool Agents) is a training-free, model-agnostic layer that represents an agent's working memory as typed, addressable blocks, attacking the failure mode where long-horizon tool agents degrade as context grows toward the window limit.
bullets.how: Our daily/weekly scan agents are exactly long-horizon tool loops that bloat context; typed, addressable working-memory blocks are a concrete pattern to keep the Lens/Prism/Pulse jobs coherent across many tool calls without dumping everything into one context.

bullets.title: Axonius ships an AI Agent + MCP Server for asset intelligence (Jul 21)
bullets.summary: Axonius connects asset-inventory and security-posture data to enterprise AI so an agent can query what's deployed and where the exposures are.
bullets.how: The pattern, not the product, is the lesson: an asset/tool inventory + posture check is exactly what our own MCP fleet needs as the Jul-28 migration lands — treat every connector as a governed asset with least-authority scoping and a migration checklist.

bullets.title: Google ships a series of cheaper Gemini models, incl. Gemini 3.6 Flash (Jul 21)
bullets.summary: Google widened the Gemini line with lower-cost tiers aimed at high-volume workloads, with 3.6 Flash the newest fast/cheap default.
bullets.how: Keeps the cost/quality split clean for the fleet: cheap Flash for high-volume batch text/image passes, a reasoning tier only for jobs that need it; benchmark against current defaults before rewiring anything load-bearing.

bullets.title: Featured launches an MCP server bringing AI agents to PR agencies (GA Jul 2026)
bullets.summary: Featured connects Claude/Cursor/VS Code to a Featured account so one natural-language request surfaces media queries, journalists, podcasts, byline publications, LinkedIn influencers, speaking engagements with open CFPs, and awards.
bullets.how: A ready-made earned-media/PR data source for the Brand 9 Signs + PRAGMA owned-presence wedge: a Construct comms agent could pull relevant queries and CFPs before drafting outreach, extending the 'AI drafts, human approves' module into PR.

praxis_lesson: On a quiet Sunday with no new Anthropic drop since Friday's MCP-to-Agentic-AI-Foundation donation, the board's center of gravity stays the plumbing, not the models: the stateless rewrite ratifies in 2 days and touches every write-capable connector we run, so the single load-bearing action remains the migration + least-authority hardening inventory before Tuesday. The supporting theme is context discipline — VISTA's typed, addressable working memory is the research-grade version of the same problem our long-running scan agents already hit, and the governance-as-assets framing (Axonius) is how to walk into the migration clean.
